import plistlib, struct, protocols as p
def frame(d):
    b=plistlib.dumps(d, fmt=plistlib.FMT_BINARY if d.get('Key')=='ProductName' else plistlib.FMT_XML)
    return struct.pack('>I', len(b))+b
payload = frame({'Key':'ProductVersion','Request':'GetValue','Value':'17.4'})+frame({'Key':'ProductName','Request':'GetValue','Value':'iPhone'})

print(p.signature('sync', payload+b'x'))
print(p.signature('sync', payload[:len(payload)-1]))

f=struct.pack('>I',len(xml))+xml
